journal_lines: A pack emerged from the tree line. Did not run. Neither did they. When the moon moved, both groups went their separate ways.
Yellow eyes in the dark. Held the ground. They held theirs. Eventually the night settled it.
Territorial. Both of us. Stood until one side lost interest. Was not us.
Wild pack. Six of them. Neither side interested in making the first mistake.
The alpha walked the line. Held it. Eventually they all moved on.
Not ours, not claimed, not contested. Eventually.
Yellow eyes from three directions. Stood still. Waited them out.
A long negotiation between two sides with no common language. Reached agreement.
Held ground for an hour in the dark. They held theirs. The moon moved. We parted.
Wild wolves in the territory. Held the scent trail. They read it. Moved on.
The pack was older than expected. Wiser too. Both sides chose correctly.
Stood in the open while they watched from the tree line. Neither blinked. Eventually it ended.
